g.text: BC-03 Catalog & Commercial Policy — Tactical Domain Model (TARGET / V1)
+resolveOffer(skuId: SkuId, customerId: CustomerAccountId, at: Instant): ResolvedOfferSnapshot
+findActiveFor(skuId: SkuId, customerId: CustomerAccountId, at: Instant): ResolvedOfferSnapshot
Price precedence: Base Price -> Price List -> Customer Terms -> max one Promotion.

ResolvedOfferSnapshot is the Published Language contract for BC-04 with canonical fields skuId, unitPrice, termsSnapshot, optional promotionId [0..1] and effectiveAt; it is not a Published Integration Event or shared aggregate.
CustomerAccountId is a non-owning BC-02 reference.
